metaDescription: Affordable, reliable printing for the Shinawatra University community. Black-and-white and colour printing, with convenient campus delivery.
heroBody: From class notes to last-minute assignments, get quality printing at fair prices with friendly service. We're here to help you get your work ready before the deadline.
campusNote: We currently accept orders within the Shinawatra University main campus area only.
qualityText: Get sharp black-and-white prints and vibrant colour, with your documents reproduced clearly and carefully.
valueText: Know the cost of your print order before sending us your files.
deliveryText: Have your order delivered to your accommodation or another convenient location on campus.
servicesBody: Whether you need a single page in a hurry or a complete set of class notes, we're here to make getting your printing done simple and convenient.
pricingBody: Prices are per A4 sheet. Single-sided and double-sided printing cost the same.
samePrice: Single-sided and double-sided printing cost the same
contactBody: Send us your files, let us know how many copies you need and how you'd like to receive your order. We'll help you arrange the details.
areaBody: We currently accept orders within the Shinawatra University main campus area, making it convenient to arrange printing when you need it.
